description.en: Force-hides archived sessions from the DSH conversation list whatever the sidebar view filter says, and adds a panel to unarchive them or delete them permanently - session log directory, archive and pin records, and projection cache.
description.zh: 无论侧栏「归档显示」如何设置都强制隐藏已归档会话，并提供管理面板：取消归档，或彻底删除会话日志目录、归档与置顶登记及投影缓存。
